accepted_findings.claim: On Windows, editable GUI scripts use the console-script wrapper and python.exe instead of the windowed launcher.

evidence_receipt.claim: On Windows, editable GUI scripts use the console-script wrapper and python.exe instead of the windowed launcher.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: The code shows that console_scripts and gui_scripts are combined into a single list and processed identically. On Windows (line 106), the same WINDOWS_CMD_TEMPLATE wrapper using `python.exe` is applied to all scripts including GUI scripts, rather than using `pythonw.exe` for GUI scripts. This means GUI scripts on Windows get the console-script wrapper with python.exe instead of a windowed launcher (pythonw.exe).
